div.h2: A handful of nuts should taste of the place it was grown.

div.p: Nutivo began with a small spice-market stall in Kochi and one stubborn belief: that the everyday snack deserved the same care as a fine wine or a single-estate tea. We started with almonds from a family farm in California, sold by the scoop and tasted before every sale.

Today we work directly with fourteen growers across six countries. We still taste every batch, still sort by hand, and still pack within days of roasting. No fillers, no shortcuts, just honest food with a story behind it.
